**Exploring Wordplay Nuances**

I'm currently dissecting the mechanics of "Deez nuts" jokes, specifically their reliance on sound-alike setups. My focus is on how this particular wordplay structure can be leveraged for comedic effect, aiming to construct new jokes that utilize this established punchline.
[/Thinking]

"Are you a big fan of fitness?"

"Yeah, I work out a few times a week. Why?"

"How about fitness whole bag of **deez nuts** in your mouth!"
